heading: Archive manager
intro: Agents prune their own history on their own schedule. An archive is a full copy of every transcript they still hold, kept outside their reach.
retentionIntro: Archive old sessions on a rule, so they survive the agent's own cleanup. This only ever copies; it never deletes.
retentionDaysInvalid: Enter a whole number of days between {{min}} and {{max}}.
promptsIntro: Claude Code records every prompt you type and never prunes that record, so it outlives the transcripts themselves.
promptsOrphanedHint: Every transcript gone; only the prompts remain
openPromptSession: Open the session this was typed into
notePlaceholder: Optional note, for example "before the 2.0 upgrade"
noArchivesHint: Create one now and today's transcripts survive whatever the agents delete next.
deleteArchiveWarning: The archived copies are removed for good. Whatever the agents have since deleted cannot be recovered afterwards.
storageIntro: What each agent is holding on disk. Reading only: deciding what is safe to remove is a separate question.
storagePartial: At least this much; the scan stopped at its limit
storageReadOnly: Nothing here is deleted by this app.
reclaimAvailable: {{size}} of it is working files the agents can rebuild.
reclaimExplain: These are caches, logs and temporary files. No transcript, archive or generated file is touched, and the agents will rebuild what they need.
reclaimFailed: Nothing was deleted: the files could not be removed.
